visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a golden-brown egg yolk pastry held between two fingers. The pastry is shiny with an egg wash finish. Small sesame seeds are visible on top. The background is a soft-focus kitchen setting. (2) Medium shot of two men standing in a studio kitchen. The man on the right has long dark hair and wears a black denim shirt; the man on the left has short hair and wears a black chef's uniform. They stand behind a white marble countertop. (3) The chef holds a vacuum-sealed bag of bright orange salted egg yolks. He struggles to open the plastic packaging while the host on the right watches and laughs. They interact playfully in the well-lit kitchen. (4) Close-up of salted egg yolks arranged on a baking tray. A hand uses a yellow spray bottle to mist the yolks with liquid. Then, liquid is poured over them from a glass container. (5) Macro shot of the egg yolks baking inside an oven. The lighting is warm and orange-hued as the yolks sizzle slightly. (6) The chef demonstrates rolling out yellow dough on the marble counter using a wooden rolling pin. He folds and rolls the dough repeatedly to create layers. (7) Close-up of a flattened piece of dark red bean paste. An egg yolk is placed in the center, and the chef's hands skillfully wrap the paste around the yolk. (8) The chef demonstrates a 'pro skill' by rolling four pieces of dough simultaneously using one long rolling pin. The host watches with wide eyes and exaggerated facial expressions. (9) The chef wraps the final dough around the red bean and yolk filling, shaping it into a perfect sphere. (10) The chef brushes bright yellow egg wash onto the tops of several pastries arranged on a black perforated baking mat. He applies two coats and adds sesame seeds. (11) Final reveal of the baked pastries. A cross-section shot shows the distinct layers of flaky crust, dark bean paste, and a moist, oily salted egg yolk in the center. (12) The two men sit at the table, each holding a half of a pastry. They smell and then taste the pastries, nodding in approval with satisfied facial expressions. (13) The chef speaks directly to the camera while holding the pastry, explaining the technical details of the 'oil skin' effect. (14) Graphic outro appears on a green background with a logo and social media search prompts.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The host has chin-length wavy dark hair and wears a black long-sleeved shirt with grey trousers. The chef, Lu Sheng-da, has short styled hair and wears a professional black chef's jacket with a white logo on the chest.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern, clean studio kitchen featuring white marble countertops, teal-colored cabinets, and shelves stocked with cooking supplies and ingredient jars.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy pop music with a steady electronic beat begins. An enthusiastic male voice introduces the 'secret to egg yolk pastry.' (2) The host and the chef engage in fast-paced dialogue with bright vocal tones. Multiple laughter sounds and a lighthearted percussion thud occur when the chef struggles with a plastic bag. (3) A series of sharp 'whoosh' and 'ding' sound effects accompany the rapid visual cuts of the egg yolk preparation. The chef's voice remains calm but informative over the continuous upbeat BGM. (4) Rhythmic rolling sounds on the counter are heard. The host lets out an exaggerated 'Oh!' followed by a 'pop' sound effect during the skill demonstration. (5) Bubbling and sizzling foley sounds are layered over the music during the oven montage. (6) The tempo of the speech increases as the men taste the pastry, punctuated by crunching sounds and energetic vocal affirmations. (7) Music swells into a final jingle for the course promotion, ending with a distinctive 'LINE VOOM' logo sound mark.
